Faculty Advertisement
Monday, 17 April 2017

Applications along with complete bio-data with necessary academic experience certificates/testimonials are invited for the following posts which must reach the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha (MS) latest by 30/04/2017. The appointments would be adhoc till the next Selection Committee of MUHS meets.
Professor
in Paediatrics, TB & Chest & Psychiatry
Associate Professor
in Radiodiagosis
Qualification:
MBBS with MCI recognized Post-graduate Degree in concerned subject.
Experience:
As per MCI & MUHS norms
Pay Scale:
As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
